description: HTTP fetch / GET any URL: exactly what the server sent, status code, headers and body, plus the final URL after redirects. Every status is a result, so a 404 or 500 from the target is delivered, not failed. Use it for API checks, uptime probes and raw HTML. Input: url. Readable text from a rendered page: extract.page. $0.10 per call.
name: hubvibe_fetch_raw
title: Raw HTTP fetch
